When a template has two or more Schema.String spans, for example: ts Schema.TemplateLiteral(Schema.String, ":", Schema.String, ":", Schema.String, "X") the regex contains several ambiguous wildcards. A non-matching input makes the backtracking engine…

item.title: iSponsorBlockTV: SSRF via Malicious SSDP Response Spoofing in Local Device Discovery
item.description: Summary iSponsorBlockTV discovers local smart TV devices via SSDP (Simple Service Discovery Protocol). The LOCATION URL from SSDP responses is used to fetch device capabilities without URL validation. A local network attacker can craft a malicious SSDP response with a LOCATION pointing to any internal HTTP service, causing SSRF when the application fetches device information. Details In src/iSponsorBlockTV/dial…

item.title: gosaml2: Unauthenticated panic decrypting an EncryptedAssertion with a short or empty CipherValue
item.description: Summary An attacker who can supply a crafted SAML Response for parsing can crash a gosaml2 service provider by sending an EncryptedAssertion with AES-GCM encryption metadata and a CipherValue shorter than the GCM nonce size (12 bytes). The library panics with slice bounds out of range before any validation completes. This is a distinct issue from GHSA-hwqm-qvj9-4jr2…

item.title: HtmlSanitizer: CSS Removal DoS
item.description: Impact An unauthenticated request can occupy one synchronous application worker for seconds. Concurrent requests add CPU cost and can keep all workers busy, sustaining denial of service without user interaction. Patches The issue has been patched in versions 9.0.967 and 9.1.968-beta. Workarounds Disallow the style attribute.

item.title: Doorkeeper: When using public clients, any client can revoke any access token
item.description: Summary An improper authorization issue affects Doorkeeper's OAuth token revocation flow when public (non-confidential) clients are in use. This vulnerability can lead to tokens being revoked without correct authorization. The issue is fixed in Doorkeeper 5.9.1.

item.title: nbdkit: qcow2dec ZSTD heap over-read via incorrect input buffer size
item.description: A flaw was found in nbdkit. The qcow2dec filter's zstd compressed cluster() function incorrectly sets the ZSTD input buffer size to the uncompressed cluster size instead of the compressed buffer size. A crafted QCOW2 image with ZSTD-compressed clusters can trigger a heap over-read, leading to a denial of service and potentially exposing heap memory.
